data.cleaned_text: Here’s a sharp, witty, and fun take on my observation on DGCA. ✈️ India’s Skyfall: Not a James Bond Movie, Just DGCA Licensing Policies 🎭 If you ever wondered why India has a higher air accident rate than most places on the planet, don’t blame the monsoon, don’t blame the pigeons, and definitely don’t blame the “biryani in the cockpit” jokes. No sir, the main villain here wears a suit, runs an office, and issues pilot licenses like a Diwali card—it’s DGCA, baby! 🎓 Welcome to the Great Indian Licensing Circus: • Ever seen a pilot do 10 takeoffs and 0 landings in a simulator? Congratulations! He just cleared his checkride. • Missed your landing checklist because you were reading WhatsApp forwards? No problem—license still granted, just keep your horoscope clean. • Stalled an aircraft in a turn? That’s not a fail in India—it’s “advanced maneuvering.” 🛫 Pilot Training or Jugaad Olympics? DGCA policies have turned pilot training into a game of “Kaun Banega Captain?” Who needs world-class instructors when your cousin knows someone at the flying club who can “adjust” your logbook? And don’t forget the license factories abroad—hello Philippines! Students go there barely knowing the difference between flaps and chapatis—and return as “Commanders.” 💡 Merit? What’s That? DGCA’s policy playbook is filled with gems like: • “If you can’t pass the exam, make the exam easier.” • “If you still fail, give grace marks for handwriting.” 🕵️‍♂️ Result? • Midair calls to ATC that sound like “Hello hello, koi hai?” • Confusion between go-around and go home. • And pilots who treat weather radar like a decorative iPad. 🛑 Meanwhile… Accident Investigation: After a crash, the committee meets and says: “Poor weather, bad luck, but pilot error. DGCA? Oh no, sir, we just issue licenses—we don’t check them!” 🎯 Moral of the Story? India doesn’t have an air safety crisis—it has an oversight crisis where paper pilots get real wings. Fix the policies, raise the standards, and maybe—just maybe—we’ll stop mistaking the sky for a gamble. Until then, fasten your seatbelts… not just for turbulence, but for policy-induced pilot roulette. 🎰✈️ 88800 <li8205 84 @ 83
